shots.prompt: The camera pushes in past his shoulder toward the gate. The woman steps out of the doorway into the rain and turns her head toward him.
The camera pulls back slowly. The two stand facing each other in the rain, neither of them moving except to breathe.
The camera moves in on his face. He blinks and water drips from his hair down his cheek as he speaks one short phrase.
The camera rises above them and looks down. The lantern swings once on its hook, and their two shadows slide across the wet stones.
The camera tilts up along the spear. She lifts it a hand's width and holds it there, rain running down the shaft.
The camera holds as she turns and walks into the dark doorway. He stays where he is, watching her go.
The camera pulls back out through the arch until the gate is small in the frame. The lantern flickers once, and the rain keeps falling on the empty road.
